native_border_geometry.runtime: Local MinGW frontend plus unchanged source-built 3ee3235 headless host; not single-file acceptance
native_border_geometry.border_cause: Partial virtual cells sampled outside the raster and repeated edge pixels instead of transparency
native_border_geometry.roundoff_cause: Consolas 7x15 cell geometry placed an exact bottom-edge sample a few double-precision ulps inside the raster, adding one row. Only machine-roundoff-sized raster-border coordinates are canonicalized; interior sampling and all pixel assertions remain unchanged.
native_border_geometry.reference_transport: Two upstream APC payloads exceed 4096 base64 characters. The initial native run returned E2BIG. Legal chunk normalization preserves every decoded byte and now checks exact graphics replies.
native_border_geometry.geometry_scope: 153 fresh upstream cell sizes provide rectangles. Native transitions cover 19 states per renderer; no claim that all 153 sizes ran natively. Nearest-neighbour sampling differs from Kitty GPU linear filtering.
